verdict.rationale: Docs require every SKILL.md to include a `name` and `description`, and the skill creator explicitly asks 'when it should trigger.' Codex also scans `.agents/skills` up the directory tree, so folder-relevant skills are discovered from the working context. Community users praise the progressive disclosure that loads skills selectively rather than stuffing context, which corroborates context-driven activation alongside explicit `$` mentions. Missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement of the automatic description-matching mechanism, guidance on writing descriptions so they trigger reliably, and hands-on evidence of activation accuracy.
